title: Budget variance review

chrome.note: Title Slide uses createImage of cover-gradient.png only when a real Drive ID or public URL is set; otherwise pageBackgroundFill is Ballpoint and cover type is Paper. The smile comes from the imported layouts unless --place-smile is set.

note: Send only the requests array to update_presentation after the createSlide batch. Slide IDs are the planned wd_sN values. Re-run with --presentation get.json if IDs differ. If you used --chunk, send fills-01, fills-02, ... in order.
